notes: Titles are the IRS's own headlines; two list-page anchor texts were stale and were replaced with the verified article headlines (TN-2026-01, IR-2025-41).

postponed_to is parsed from the headline; where the headline omits the year it is inferred from the announcement code and flagged. The headline is a summary - the article carries the covered localities and any later updates (see TN-2026-01).
Engine relevance: a disaster postponement under IRC 7508A moves the due date itself, so these rows are dated brackets for due-date overrides, keyed by state.
Backlog: the same page lists ~108 further entries for 2024 (postponements all expired in 2024-2025), not yet harvested.
Eight 2026 entries overlap data/tip-pool.json (harvested earlier from the Newsroom index); this file is the state-keyed collection.
